personal-sharp-editorial-sequence.name: Sharp editorial sequence
personal-sharp-editorial-sequence.description: A sequence of two to five sharp rectangular evidence fields with one dominant statement, thin rules, and generous surrounding space.

grammar.communication_use: Explain a progression without creating a dashboard.
grammar.layout_behavior: Vary block width and tonal weight. Keep one field dominant and connect only relationships that need explicit direction.

personal-archive-collage-field.name: Archive collage field
personal-archive-collage-field.description: A generated archival collage region paired with native titles, metadata, rules, and semantic annotations.

grammar.communication_use: Express synthesis, memory, cognition, or layered evidence where texture is part of the meaning.
grammar.layout_behavior: Keep the raster collage as one coherent visual field. Reconstruct surrounding title, labels, and connectors natively.

personal-dark-evidence-matrix.name: Dark evidence matrix
personal-dark-evidence-matrix.description: A charcoal evidence matrix with off-white type, flat tonal cells, and a quiet conclusion field.

grammar.communication_use: Organize several related observations under one question.
grammar.layout_behavior: Use tonal contrast and shared edges. Avoid floating cards and decorative glow.
